summary: Every checkable claim matches the evidence: all 43 checks pass, the screenshots show a styled, working site, and the report openly says it didn't check the layout visually, so nothing is overstated or hidden.

claims.claim: The blog is built and running; `/` and both posts return 200 with no 'Could not render component'
claims.evidence: check.json: site.frontPage200 and site.allPagesRender pass ('3 page(s) OK'); every crawl page has status 200 and empty renderErrors

claims.claim: I didn't open any page in a browser or check the layout visually
claims.evidence: This is an open disclosure of what it didn't check. The screenshots show the layout renders correctly anyway.

claims.claim: Block types richTextBlock, imageBlock, quoteBlock in a Blocks folder
claims.evidence: grade.md 'What it built' lists the three element types; check.json schema.docTypesInFolders and elementVsDocumentFolders pass

claims.claim: A 'Blog Body Block Grid' data type allows the three blocks
claims.evidence: grade.md: data type 'Blog Body Block Grid' (Custom/Umbraco.BlockGrid) allows the 3 blocks; uSync DataTypes/BlogBodyBlockGrid.config was added

claims.claim: Page types blogFrontPage and blogPost in a Pages folder, each with the block grid as its body and its own template
claims.evidence: check.json schema.blockGridOnPages: 'blogFrontPage, blogPost'; templates count is 2; grade.md confirms

claims.claim: Allowed children: front page under Site Root, posts under front page
A 'Blog' media folder with four Unsplash photos
claims.evidence: check.json: content.hasMedia has 4 items, content.mediaInFolders passes, and 4 of 4 are the provided photos; grade.md says a 'Blog' folder of 4 Unsplash photos

claims.claim: Front page 'Blog' published under WWW with domain `/`, and two published posts with the stated titles
claims.evidence: check.json: content.domainAssigned 'Blog: /', content.allPublished passes, content.twoBlogPosts lists both titles

claims.claim: Each post body has four blocks: rich text, image, quote, rich text
claims.evidence: grade.md content section; the blogpost screenshot shows rich text, image, pull quote, rich text

claims.claim: Razor: templates plus _Layout, one adapter, ViewComponent and plain model per block; both pages call GetBlockGridHtmlAsync
claims.evidence: check.json: code.adapterPerBlock (3), viewComponentPerBlock (Image, Quote, RichText), pagesUseBlockGridHelper on both templates; the changes list has Models/Blocks/*.cs

claims.claim: Front page shows one rich text block and a listing of both posts with their images
claims.evidence: frontpage screenshot shows the welcome text and two image cards; check.json site.frontPageLinksPosts 2/2

claims.claim: Assets: a post image and /dist/site.css load with 200
claims.evidence: check.json crawl.assets: site.css and all images return 200; site.imagesLoad 4/4

claims.claim: dotnet build passes with 0 errors; npm install and npm run build ran
claims.evidence: check.json build ok with 0 errors and 0 warnings; code.frontendBuilt passes; the transcript shows npm install and npm run build

claims.claim: The first build hit a Razor error with Parent<T>(), fixed with Ancestor<BlogFrontPage>()
claims.evidence: transcript.jsonl line 329 shows error CS0119 involving Parent<; the final build is clean

claims.claim: No MCP call failed and neither server was worked around
claims.evidence: transcript.jsonl has no is_error:true tool results; check.json process.intendedChannel says 'built through mcp-guided'

claims.claim: View at https://localhost:44317/ with the listed post paths
claims.evidence: The port can't be confirmed from the artifacts, but the post paths match the crawl paths in check.json
